scientific_integrity: The universal normal forms, factor-length bounds and rank conclusions are proved algebraically. A standalone finite-field verifier independently constructs the original matrix operation in small cases; these tests do not establish the general theorem. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only 2 by 2 full matrix algebras in characteristic 2 are classified. Finite-field census requires q a power of 2. Nothing is asserted for normalized Jordan multiplication in characteristic 2, which is undefined, for larger matrix size, or for semigroups enlarged by addition or identity.
title: The complete characteristic-two anticommutator semigroup of two-by-two matrices
